notes.title: Story Mode Added
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301942/8e2bfeb2c7af0ed852a5dc6f5b704aa02e9a4a07.png

Story Mode added for your reading (and replaying) convenience. It integrates the main plot in a more linear manner, with slight changes in the plot and scenes.

Differences between the Modes:

1. Story Mode:

   - Main storyline with only the relevant POVs unlocked,

   - 3 out of 8 endings available

2. Exploration Mode:

    - 3 routes (X, Levon, mixed) with 2 branches per route,

    - Multiple branches of varying lengths,

    - 8 out of 8 endings available,

    - Unlockable achievements,

    - In-game guide included in achievements, after completing one ending,

    - All  POVs unlocked on replay for corresponding scenes,

    - 9 CGs and 13 item images
